claim_summary: The coupled six-site fixture's rescued pinning does not make the full signature even-windable: pinning both appended coordinates as holes recovers F4 exactly, and all cross-coordinate auxiliary edges are inactive. More generally, any coordinate-pair auxiliary extension preserving the F4 block retains this non-even-windable pinning, even if another marginal is repaired.
scope: Extensions whose old four-site principal block is preserved and whose auxiliary operations are coordinate-pair additions. Does not rule out representations that remove this pinning or arbitrary local energy flows.
